title: Orbital Remnants: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Orbital Remnants loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Check oxygen reserves, suit integrity, return route, and emergency supplies before boarding anything that can strand you away from base.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first orbital run succeeds when oxygen, suit state, return path, and one salvage goal are all decided before boarding anything that can strand you.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Orbital Remnants is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
